Teaching is not a side activity for me. A workflow that nobody else can run is not
reproducible, so most of my training work is about closing that gap — turning FAIR
principles and governance policy into guidance people can apply on a Tuesday afternoon.

## ELIXIR-UK Data Stewardship Training

As Lead Data Stewardship Trainer I design and deliver around **30 hands-on workshops
and webinars a year** on research data management, FAIR data, workflow automation,
reproducible tooling and AI-assisted work, for audiences from clinical fellows to
software developers.

Within the **DaSH Fellowship** I mentor **24 Fellows across 17 organisations** through
one-to-one coaching, competency-based portfolio review and practical troubleshooting,
and evaluate the programme using qualitative feedback, observation and reflection to
feed findings back into the curriculum.

## ELIXIR / GOBLET Train-the-Trainer (2024–2027)

Co-lead of a train-the-trainer programme spanning **seven European ELIXIR Nodes and
EMBL-EBI**, strengthening course design, delivery, assessment and the instructor
community across the network.

## Galaxy Training Network

Contributor to **26 published or peer-reviewed open-access tutorials and learning
resources** in the [Galaxy Training Network](https://training.galaxyproject.org),
with editorial-board work on technical accuracy, clarity and reproducibility.

## What I teach

::: {.card-grid}
::: {}
#### Reproducible workflows

Nextflow DSL2 and nf-core, Galaxy, Docker and Singularity, version control, running
analyses on HPC and cloud.
:::

::: {}
#### FAIR data and stewardship

Metadata models, persistent identifiers, data lineage and ownership, data management
plans, governance and compliance.
:::

::: {}
#### Epigenomics analysis

Illumina methylation array analysis end to end, for people who do not write code.
:::

::: {}
#### AI and automation for research

LLM-assisted workflows, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, and the safety
and data-protection questions that come with them.
:::
:::
